lead.tldr: SafeMoon CEO sentenced to 8 years for $9M investor theft highlighting scam prosecution risks. • LayerZero launches Zero chain with Citadel and ARK backing signaling TradFi blockchain entry. • Franklin Templeton enables tokenized funds as Binance collateral bridging CeFi and crypto. • Robinhood debuts Arbitrum L2 testnet targeting tokenized real-world assets. • Spark introduces institutional lending suite channeling DeFi stablecoins to credit markets. • Hyperliquid gains on Coinbase in exchange metrics pressuring centralized platforms.

top_signals.title: SafeMoon CEO Given 8-Year Jail Time Over Crypto Scam
top_signals.summary: Braden John Karony, former CEO of SafeMoon, was sentenced to 100 months in federal prison after a jury convicted him in May 2025 on charges including conspiracy to commit securities fraud, wire fraud, and money laundering. Karony misappropriated over $9 million in digital assets from SafeMoon's liquidity pool in 2021, diverting investor funds to purchase luxury properties and vehicles while publicly denying any risk of a rug pull. The SafeMoon token had reached an $8 billion market capitalization in 2021 before collapsing 98% by 2023, leaving investors including military veterans and everyday Americans with substantial losses. This conviction reflects an expanding enforcement trend against crypto executives who manipulate tokens and misappropriate funds, with comparable sentences recently imposed on FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried (25 years) and Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky (12 years).

top_signals.title: Mansions and sports cars: former SafeMoon CEO sentenced to 8 years in prison for crypto scheme
top_signals.summary: Braden John Karony, the former CEO of SafeMoon US LLC, has been sentenced to eight years in prison. The sentencing is related to a crypto scheme.

top_signals.title: Citadel and Ark Invest back LayerZero as it launches blockchain, partners with Google Cloud and DTCC
top_signals.summary: Citadel Securities and Ark Invest have invested in LayerZero's native ZRO token as LayerZero launches its blockchain and partners with Google Cloud and DTCC. This marks a first crypto investment for Citadel.

top_signals.title: Franklin Templeton, Binance roll out program letting institutions use tokenized money funds as trading collateral
top_signals.summary: Franklin Templeton and Binance are launching a program that allows institutional traders to use tokenized money market funds as collateral for trading. This structure enables institutions to maintain assets in regulated custody while participating in crypto markets.

top_signals.title: Why Hyperliquid is ‘quietly outgrowing’ Coinbase on THESE fronts
top_signals.summary: Hyperliquid is reportedly gaining traction and potentially outperforming Coinbase in certain aspects of the 'everything exchange' race. The article suggests Hyperliquid has an early lead in this area.

top_signals.title: Stripe adds x402 integration for USDC agent payments on Base
top_signals.summary: Stripe has integrated x402 for USDC agent payments on the Base network. CoinGecko now offers pay-per-request crypto data access for as little as $0.01.

top_signals.title: Spark Launches Institutional Lending Suite to Channel DeFi Stablecoins
top_signals.summary: Spark has launched Spark Prime and Spark Institutional Lending, aiming to channel DeFi stablecoin liquidity into institutional credit markets. This move seeks to bridge the gap between DeFi and traditional finance by providing institutional access to stablecoin lending.

top_signals.title: Franklin Templeton to Let Tokenized Money Funds Back Binance Trades
top_signals.summary: Franklin Templeton is enabling its tokenized money funds, specifically Benji, to be used as off-exchange collateral for Binance trades. This allows assets to remain in regulated custody while being utilized for trading activities.

top_signals.title: Bretton AI raises $75 million to use AI to combat financial crime
top_signals.summary: Bretton AI raised $75 million in funding from Sapphire Ventures and Greylock Partners. The company aims to use AI to combat financial crime and improve anti-money laundering prevention at financial firms.

top_signals.title: Man sentenced to 20 years for role in $74 million crypto investment fraud
top_signals.summary: Daren Li was sentenced to 20 years for his role in a $73.6 million crypto laundering conspiracy. He remains a fugitive.

top_signals.title: Robinhood launches its own blockchain as part of broader push into tokenized stocks
top_signals.summary: Robinhood has launched its own blockchain, 'Robinhood Chain', as part of a broader strategy to incorporate tokenization of various assets.

top_signals.title: Robinhood Launches Testnet for Arbitrum-Based L2 Blockchain
top_signals.summary: Robinhood has launched the public testnet for Robinhood Chain, a new Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain built on Arbitrum. The chain is focused on tokenized real-world assets.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, This week brings important lessons for our industry. Yesterday, Braden John Karony, former CEO of SafeMoon, was sentenced to 100 months in federal prison for defrauding thousands of investors. He manipulated token prices, drained liquidity pools of over $9 million, and purchased mansions and sports cars while denying any risks to his community. Military veterans and hardworking Americans lost substantial sums as SafeMoon collapsed 98% from its $8 billion peak. This conviction joins a growing list of high-profile cases, including FTX's Sam Bankman-Fried and Celsius's Alex Mashinsky, signaling that regulators are serious about prosecuting crypto fraud. These cases underscore why trust and transparency are non-negotiable in Web3. Founders who build with integrity don't just avoid legal consequences, they create lasting value for their communities and attract institutional capital. Speaking of institutional adoption, LayerZero's recent momentum is encouraging. With backing from Citadel Securities and Ark Invest, plus partnerships with Google Cloud and the DTCC, we're seeing traditional finance embrace blockchain infrastructure. This represents real progress toward mainstream integration. As venture capitalists supporting early-stage teams, we're committed to backing founders who prioritize security, compliance, and genuine innovation. The future of crypto belongs to builders who earn trust through action, not hype. How are you ensuring your projects meet the highest standards of governance and transparency? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC
